## Summary

Describe the problem and focused change.

## Compatibility

Describe public API, behavior, dependency, device, or architecture impact.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m ruff check .`
- [ ] `python -m ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `python -m pytest -W error`
- [ ] Changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] User-visible changes update README, API, usage, and changelog content.
- [ ] Performance or architecture changes include a reproducible benchmark.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, local paths, archives, builds, or caches are included.
